title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie  
Intelligence Connected

**WoodMac.com**

**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**

**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

**Job Description**

To support the development of our Lens data analytics platform, we are looking for a dynamic Senior Product Manager to be an integral part of our Commodities Product team covering Gas & LNG, Oils & Chemicals and Metals & Mining.

*Knowledge & experience*

* Experienced Product Manager, or Analyst looking to expand their role into the Product Management space
* Experience with the product development cycle including agile software development (Scrum/Kanban), design process, and instrumenting analytics.
* Basic industry knowledge and strong interest on one or multiple sectors covered in our portfolio (Gas & LNG, Oils & Chemicals, Metals & Mining), understanding of the major players, market conditions, and industry standards. Intellectual curiosity for industry is a must.
* Experience working on data migrations projects, and using AI in product development is a strong plus.
* Good oral and written communication skills
* Key tools that we use are JIRA, Productboard and Amplitude. Our tech stack is mainly on AWS and Snowflake.

*Impact on the team*

* Act as the day-to-day point person for the cross-functional team, providing a seamless bridge between Research Analysts, Data teams, UX, and Engineering to identify solutions that work within a set of defined constraints and align to the broader business strategy and achieve customer-focused results.
* Align understanding by defining user requirements with clear acceptance criteria across multiple features
* Assist in documentation and testing of given solutions to ensure fit for customers
* Collaborate with the Senior Product Manager to help communicate product value and priorities to internal teams, including sales and marketing
Foster healthy culture, support and collaboration for a distributed team  

*Stakeholder & client relationships*

* Translate requirements from customers and defining the product functionality according to wider customer needs
* Inform senior stakeholders on progress and raise risks to the appropriate level
* Engage frequently with users to gather feedback from relevant customers and internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Marketing and Sales to enable go-to-market effort

**Equal Opportunities**

We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. You can find out more about your rights under the law at www.eeoc.gov

title: Senior Product Manager (Tier 1 & 5+ Years experience)
description:
**About Us:**

**Luna is a health intelligence company**. Our wearables and LifeOS platform build a working model of your body, and turn it into a plan for your day. Luna Ring and Luna Band read continuous biomarker signals, from sleep and recovery to heart rate variability, circadian phase and menstrual cycle. LifeOS combines that with your nutrition, supplements, blood panels and daily context to build a plan for your day: what to do, and when to do it. Luna ships to 150+ countries, and our work has been recognised by the global tech press and international design and innovation awards.

We're grounded in science, driven by data, and occasionally powered by questionable coffee choices. But above all, we’re united by a shared mission: to reimagine how wearable tech can help people know themselves better and push their potential further.

**Your Role:**

We’re looking for a Product Manager – App to lead our health-tech experience and build our LifeOS.

You’ll work closely with design, engineering, CX, and our beta community to deliver features that are elegant, evidence-based, and habit-forming.

**Responsibilities:**

● Own and evolve the entire Luna App roadmap, including onboarding, dashboard design,

insights, and user journeys.

● Lead product discovery and delivery for high-impact features like Energy OS, Circadian Rhythm,

Sleep Recovery and AI-based health layer.

● Have a strong understanding towards building algorithms

● Drive measurable improvements in app retention, App Store rating, feature adoption, and

session engagement.

● Translate complex physiological and behavioral science into simple, engaging app flows.

● Use data (Amplitude / Firebase / Mixpanel) to learn user behaviour

● Interact on and close the loop on feedback from beta groups and other digital communities.

**Requirements:**

*Must-Have:*

● 5+ years of product experience, with at least 2+ years leading a consumer mobile app

● Bachelors/M.S/Phd in Data Science, ML, Statistics from a Tier 1 college

● Personal interest in quantified self, training, mindfulness, sleep science, or longevity

● Experience in deep-healthtech, wellness, wearables, or fitness—with user empathy and domain

fluency.

● Exposure to AI productization, health APIs

● Strong data, algorithms understanding is critical to this role.

● Demonstrated ability to improve app retention, adoption, or ratings through thoughtful product

changes.

● Deep familiarity with mobile UX, behavioral design, and habit loop creation.

● Comfort with using data tools (Amplitude, Firebase, etc.) and setting clear success metrics.

● High clarity of thought; can operate independently, structure ambiguity, and move

cross-functional teams.

● A strong POV on what makes a truly great app experience in the wellness space.

**What You’ll Get:**

● A front-row seat to the future of wearable intelligence

● Massive ownership and impact on a fast-growing global product

● Chance to build the world’s most advanced LifeOS.

● Competitive compensation + ESOPs

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What is your Current CTC?
* What is the Notice Period in your current Company?

title: Vice President – Retail Banking
description:
Job Description: Vice President – Retail Banking

**Company:** HDFC Bank  
**Department:** Retail Banking / Business Banking  
**Job Title:** Vice President – Retail Banking  
**Experience:** 10–18 Years  
**Industry:** Banking and Financial Services

Job Summary

The Vice President – Retail Banking is responsible for leading retail banking business operations, driving revenue growth, expanding the customer base, and strengthening the bank's market position across assigned regions or business segments. The role involves developing business strategies, managing branch and relationship-management teams, increasing customer acquisition and retention, optimizing portfolio performance, and ensuring compliance with applicable banking regulations and internal policies.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead and manage retail banking business operations across assigned regions, branches, or customer segments.
* Develop and execute strategies to achieve business growth, revenue, profitability, and portfolio targets.
* Drive customer acquisition, relationship expansion, customer retention, and long-term portfolio growth.
* Lead, mentor, and manage branch banking teams, relationship managers, and sales professionals.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with high-value customers, affluent clients, and other key customer segments.
* Drive cross-selling of retail banking products, including savings and current accounts, deposits, loans, credit cards, investments, and insurance, as applicable.
* Identify new business opportunities and develop market strategies to strengthen customer engagement and market share.
* Monitor business performance, portfolio quality, revenue generation, and operational efficiency.
* Oversee portfolio management and support effective identification, monitoring, and mitigation of business and credit risks.
* Ensure adherence to RBI regulations, applicable KYC and AML requirements, internal policies, and compliance standards.
* Collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to implement strategic business initiatives.
* Prepare periodic business reviews, management reports, forecasts, and performance analyses.
* Establish performance objectives and monitor team productivity against business goals.
* Improve customer experience by strengthening service quality, relationship management, and operational processes.
* Promote a culture of accountability, ethical sales practices, risk awareness, and continuous improvement.

Candidate Requirements

* Graduate degree from a recognized university.
* MBA/PGDM in Finance, Banking, Business Administration, or Management preferred.
* 10–18 years of relevant experience in retail banking or financial services.
* Demonstrated experience in leading large teams and managing regional or multi-branch business operations.
* Proven track record of revenue generation, customer acquisition, portfolio growth, and target achievement.
* Strong understanding of retail banking products, customer segments, and distribution channels.
* Experience in business planning, financial performance monitoring, and portfolio management.
* Good understanding of banking regulations, risk management, KYC, AML, and compliance requirements.
* Excellent leadership, strategic thinking, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to build high-performing teams and drive business transformation.
* Experience with leading private-sector banks, NBFCs, or established financial institutions preferred.

Required Skills

* Retail Banking and Branch Banking
* Sales Leadership and Business Development
* Strategic Planning and Execution
* Revenue Growth and Profitability Management
* Customer Acquisition and Retention
* Relationship Management
* Portfolio Management
* Profit and Loss (P&L) Management
* Team Leadership and Performance Management
* Cross-Selling and Product Penetration
* Banking Products and Financial Services
* Risk Management and Regulatory Compliance
* Stakeholder Management
* Business Analytics and Performance Reporting
* Customer Experience and Service Excellence

Key Objective

To drive sustainable retail banking growth for HDFC Bank by leading high-performing teams, expanding customer relationships, increasing revenue and profitability, strengthening portfolio quality, and maintaining strong risk-management and regulatory-compliance standards.

Pay: ₹2,500,000.00 - ₹4,000,000.00 per year

title: Product Manager, EDT Solution Delivery, Workday
description:
### **Why join Stryker?**

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

Join Stryker’s enterprise technology team and play a key role in delivering and maintaining Workday integration solutions that connect critical business systems. This position focuses on leading integration development, testing, release management, and vendor coordination while ensuring scalable, high-quality solutions that support global business operations.

**What You Will Do:**

* Lead the development and delivery of Workday integration solutions connecting Workday with internal and third-party systems.
* Manage multiple integration programs, tracking milestones, deliverables, risks, and overall development progress.
* Oversee integration testing activities, including code reviews, functional validation, and defect resolution.
* Configure and maintain Workday integrations using Workday Studio, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), APIs, XML, XSLT, and Workday Prism.
* Create and support custom reports, calculated fields, and integration frameworks to meet business requirements.
* Manage change requests and release processes, ensuring timely deployment and compliance with quality standards.
* Coordinate and review the work of external vendors and third-party development partners throughout the development lifecycle.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute to resource planning, workload management, and global team initiatives.
* What You Will Need

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 12 years of experience in software development, systems integration, or enterprise application development.
* Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in Workday integration development.
* Experience with Workday Studio, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), Workday Prism, XML, XSLT, and API integrations.
* Experience creating custom reports, calculated fields, and Workday integrations.
* Experience with Workday security configuration and business process configuration.
* Experience troubleshooting and resolving Workday technical and integration issues.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience leading enterprise integration programs involving multiple stakeholders and vendors.
* Experience working in Agile software development and release management environments.
* Additional Information
* Work arrangement: Hybrid or onsite based on business needs and location requirements.
* May collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.
* Limited travel may be required based on project and business needs.
* Relocation support is subject to business requirements and local policy.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Account Manager, SBS Engage, GCS
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in sales, business development, advertising, account management, marketing, or consulting.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA/Master’s Degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in sales, advertising, account management, or marketing.
* Experience leading and managing multiple projects with a broad range of internal/external stakeholders simultaneously.
* Knowledge of traditional and online marketing strategy, tactics, and products across all digital advertising product areas.
* Knowledge of the local market and ability to think strategically about complex issues and develop recommendations/action plans.

**About the job**
-----------------

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

Google Customer Solutions (GCS) sales teams are trusted advisors and competitive sellers who maintain a relentless focus on customer success by bringing the best Google has to offer to small- and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), which are the backbone of our communities. As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with company owners and make a real difference in their businesses by helping them grow. Together, we help shape the future of innovation for customers, partners, and sellers...and we have fun doing it.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage a portfolio of customers to consistently deliver against goals, while prioritizing and delivering an excellent experience to customers.
* Establish credibility with executives and act as a trusted consultant to optimize/expand their advertising investment, understand business drivers, identify opportunities for growth, manage risks, and create multi-quarter plans for sustainable business growth.
* Drive business growth, long-term partnerships, business planning/strategy, reviews, and education for customers.
* Drive customer growth and contribute to overall team success.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to enable customer growth.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Brand Manager - Ostocalcium
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.


**JOB PURPOSE:**

The Brand Manager – Ostocalcium role will deliver sustainable business growth by shaping brand strategy, identifying consumer and category opportunities, leading innovation and communication plans, and ensuring effective commercialization across channels and markets


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 

* Deliver topline, P\&L and full year plans for the brand.
* Strategize and execute to deliver aligned brand objectives – to accelerate brand penetration gains.
* Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies and activations to drive brand growth and market share gains.
* Create and execute innovative, consumer\-centric marketing campaigns across multiple channels (digital, traditional, in\-store, Dcomm etc).
* Drive product positioning, ensuring alignment with consumer needs, market trends, and company objectives.
* Performance management \& Budgeting\- Plan, execute, and optimize marketing campaigns, ensuring alignment with budget and objectives. Track campaign performance, analyze results, and adjust strategies for optimal ROI.
* Influence senior cross\-functional stakeholders to align commercial, category, sales, and marketing priorities.
* Provide strategic direction to agencies and internal teams to ensure consistent brand positioning.
* Cross functional collaboration and Agency Management.

**Why you?**

**Basic Qualifications:**

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:


* MBA/masters from an institute of repute.
* Minimum 4 years of total experience, with 2\+ years in brand management.
* Strong stakeholder management and leadership skills.
* Proven experience in developing and executing brand strategies and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Strong understanding of consumer insights, market research, brand equity, and portfolio management.
* Experience managing cross\-functional stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Insights, and R\&D.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:


* Experience in FMCG or consumer healthcare sector.
* Demonstrated track record of driving business growth, market share gains, or successful innovation launches.
* Experience leading agencies and mentoring junior brand marketers.

Strong strategic thinking, influencing skills, and ability to operate in a fast\-paced, matrix organization.  

* 

**Job Posting End Date**

2026\-10\-17  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  

  

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  

  

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

----------------------------------------

**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**About dunnhumby**



dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca\-Cola, Meijer, Procter \& Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.


**Product**



Our Product team owns the vision, strategy and roadmap for the dunnhumby platform — the data, science and software that powers retailers and brands around the world. We work at the intersection of customer data, AI, and commercial impact, building products that turn insight into measurable growth.


**The Role**



The Senior Product Analyst plays a key role in helping us build better products through data\-driven decision making. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers, you'll transform complex product data into actionable insights that shape product strategy, improve user experiences and drive measurable business outcomes.



You'll champion product analytics across our product teams, enabling experimentation, establishing best practices and ensuring decisions are backed by meaningful data.


**What You'll Be Doing**



You'll combine analytical expertise, product knowledge and stakeholder collaboration to deliver insights that influence product direction and maximise customer value.


* Own product analytics across a portfolio of products, defining key metrics and ensuring they are measured, reported and understood effectively
* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers and Product Designers to support product strategy, objectives and key results (OKRs)
* Identify opportunities to improve product performance through data analysis, experimentation and evidence\-based recommendations
* Work closely with Data Engineers and product squads to ensure the right data is captured, modelled and available for meaningful analysis
* Deliver end\-to\-end analytics, from defining requirements and success metrics through to presenting insights and recommendations to stakeholders
* Build, maintain and continuously improve product performance dashboards that provide clear, actionable visibility into product health
* Support product discovery, roadmap planning and experimentation by providing data\-driven insights and commercial context
* Leverage multiple data sources to identify trends, answer business questions and uncover new opportunities for product improvement
* Continuously improve analytics practices, reporting tools, data visualisation and automation to enable faster, more effective decision making
* Communicate insights clearly through compelling data visualisation and storytelling tailored to technical and non\-technical audiences


**What We're Looking For**



You'll bring strong analytical capability, curiosity and a passion for using data to solve product challenges while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.


* Experience in product analytics, product management, product ownership or a similar analytics\-focused role within a software or technology environment
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting complex data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations
* Experience working with cross\-functional product teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers
* Knowledge of product metrics, experimentation, performance measurement and product analytics best practices
* Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through effective data visualisation and storytelling
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision making through data
* Understanding of statistical analysis, product performance measurement and commercial drivers
* Experience on Heap,Fullstory or Amplitude
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification


**What You Can Expect From Us**



We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.



And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process — please let your recruiter know what adjustments would help.


**India Benefits**


* Healthcare \& Family Cover: Group Medical Insurance of INR 500,000 for employees and dependents, plus dental and vision cover up to INR 5,000\.
* Protection: Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover with benefit levels linked to employee grade, including disability benefits.
* Retirement \& Wellbeing: Provident Fund, Gratuity, National Pension Scheme access, Indian Health Organisation membership, and confidential employee assistance support.
* Lifestyle \& Flexibility: Office commute support, internet allowance of INR 2,000 per month for blended working, work\-from\-home kit support, subsidised food, and wellbeing resources.
* Recognition \& Extras: Long service awards, Talent Scout referral programme, and family milestone support.
* Time Off \& Family Leave: 25 days holiday plus 10 public holidays, paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and a day off for your birthday.


**Our approach to Flexible Working**



At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.



We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.



For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found(here)

title: Relationship Manager (Telesales)
description:
Key Responsibilities

* **Outbound \& Inbound Calling:** Make outbound calls to pre\-qualified or database leads and handle incoming customer inquiries regarding loans.
* **Pitching Products:** Explain features, interest rates, eligibility criteria, and benefits of loan products (e.g., Personal Loans, Business Loans, Home Loans, or Car Loans).
* **Needs Analysis:** Assess customer financial profiles to recommend the best\-fit loan product.
* **Document Coordination:** Follow up with interested clients for document collection and application completion. Coordinate with field sales or processing teams.
* **CRM Management:** Accurately update customer details, call outcomes, and lead statuses in the CRM database.
* **Target Achievement:** Meet and exceed daily/monthly connectivity, lead generation, and sales closure targets.

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹350,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Strategic Account Manager, Account Management
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


In this role the Account Manager will manage a set of critical seller accounts which contribute to 10%\+ business of the sales organization. She/He will be responsible to develop strong relationships with top sellers in the category and drive improvements in customer facing inputs and achieve category objectives.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Managing the seller relationship by championing the seller’s needs at Amazon. Build strong communication channels at all levels of the seller’s organization, set proper expectations, provide clear status communications, and manage towards a growth plan.  

* Managing and driving the growth of the seller’s business: Build and execute on a strategic account plan that delivers on key business opportunities for the seller and Amazon.
* Managing key improvement initiatives and projects: Drive new product launches and relationship extensions by partnering with the business development and onboarding teams.
* Work with sellers to improve operational aspects of their business in providing a great consumer experience.
* Analyzing the business: Conduct deep dive analysis and provide routine executive\-level reporting on the seller’s current business and future opportunities. Publish recommendations and action plans based on data.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in account management, brand management, performance marketing, digital marketing, sales or consulting

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2\+ years of work experience

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
